relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsaicin, the agonist of TRPV1, could selectively activate TRPV1, inducing Ca2+ influx and related signaling pathways

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: It is known that after TRPV1 activation, nociceptors release a variety of neuropeptides, including substance P and CGRP

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 channels are also activated by various pro-inflammatory factors, such as prostaglandins, serotonin (5-HT), bradykinin, histamine, CGRP α, tumor necrosis factor α (TNFα)

key_findings: Bibliometric analysis of 9,113 TRPV1 publications identified clusters: neuralgia, endocannabinoid system, airway hyperresponsiveness, apoptosis, antagonists as therapeutic targets.
Recent TRPV1 research has broadened to inflammation, oxidative stress and apoptosis.
